name: Curative Animal Salve
summary: Across Darkshore and the Barrens, druids use Curative Animal Salve to treat sick wildlife. Herbalists prepare it in both lands, while the Cenarion Circle sees the animals’ afflictions as signs of a wider blight.

sections.title: Mending the Wilds
sections.body: Druids use Curative Animal Salve to ease sick wildlife in Darkshore and the Barrens. Alanndarian Nightsong directs young druids to treat sick deer between the Cliffspring River and the borders of Ashenvale. In the Barrens, Tonga Runetotem brews the same remedy for sick gazelles grazing north of the Crossroads. Each herbalist prepares the salve from locally gathered herbs in batches of ten doses. Field practitioners apply it directly to the animals, while both herbalists work with local authorities to produce larger supplies.

sections.title: Symptoms of a Deeper Malaise
sections.body: The salve eases an animal’s suffering, but the Cenarion Circle sees the afflictions as signs of a wider disturbance. In Moonglade, Dendrite Starblaze observes that the afflicted deer on the coast and the suffering gazelles on the savannah are no random casualties. They are unwitting victims of a blight spreading across Kalimdor from multiple directions. For initiates, treating the animals tests their dedication to protecting nature and their skill in cleansing poison.

faq.q: What is Curative Animal Salve used for?
aliases: how to use curative animal salve
faq.answer: Druids apply Curative Animal Salve directly to afflicted wildlife to ease its ailments. They use it on sick deer in Darkshore and sick gazelles grazing north of the Crossroads in the Barrens.

aliases: where does the salve come from
faq.answer: In Darkshore, Alanndarian Nightsong prepares the salve from gathered herbs. In the Barrens, Tonga Runetotem brews it at the Crossroads for Horde druids.

faq.q: Why are the deer and gazelles sick in the first place?
faq.answer: Dendrite Starblaze of the Cenarion Circle says the wildlife are victims of a growing taint spreading across Kalimdor. The deer and gazelles are early casualties of an ecological blight.

faq.q: How many doses does a batch contain?
faq.answer: A standard batch contains ten doses, enough for ten applications.

angles.text: As a druid, treating wildlife with this salve tests your dedication to the Cenarion Circle’s work across Kalimdor and your skill in cleansing poison.
As a tauren, using the salve in the Barrens reflects how tauren druids follow Cenarius’s teachings and work in harmony with ancestral circle rites to heal the earth.
